items.description: An exact CPT (Critical Pull Time) and the quantity due at it.

cpt.description: The last moment a parcel in this bucket can be manifested and still make its truck.

quantity.description: Units due by this CPT. int64, not int32: the impl and its JSONB store accept quantities across the full 64-bit range.

sku.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045, pack-aware estimate). The SKU this bucket counts. With a `sku`, the response bucket also carries `handles`, `cubeMm3` and `weightG`, estimated from this service's local copy of the SKU's pack levels (never a live lookup). `quantity` stays in EACHES either way. Omit it (or send null or a blank value, all treated as absent) for a plain bucket, which is returned exactly as before.

pickUnit.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045; null is treated as omitted), only meaningful with `sku` (sent without one it is a `400 invalid-pick-plan`). `EACH` (the default when `sku` is given without it) estimates one handle per each. `CASE` estimates cases: it needs an active CASE pack level for the SKU (otherwise `422 no-active-case-level`) and a `quantity` that is a whole number of cases (otherwise `422 quantity-not-case-multiple`). Exact, case-sensitive match; any other value is a `400 unknown-pick-unit`. With `sku`, `quantity` must be at least 1.

handles.description: Response only; present when the bucket was sent with a `sku`. What an operator handles to move `quantity` eaches: cases for `pickUnit` `CASE` (`quantity` / units per case), eaches for `EACH`.

cubeMm3.description: Response only; total cube of all `handles`, in cubic millimetres. Omitted (never reported as 0) when the pack level has no size on record.

weightG.description: Response only; total weight of all `handles`, in grams. Omitted (never reported as 0) when the pack level has no weight on record.

receivedAt.description: When this forecast was recorded (server clock).
